requirements.quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured
requirements.text: The AFS headlamp shall be so designed and constructed that under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding the vibrations it is subjected to, its satisfactory operation remains assured.

requirements.quote: Lamps shall be so made that they give adequate illumination without dazzle when emitting the passing-beam, and good illumination when emitting the driving-beam.
requirements.text: The AFS headlamp shall give adequate illumination without dazzle when emitting any passing-beam mode.

requirements.quote: Lamps shall be fitted with a device enabling them to be so adjusted on the vehicles as to comply with the rules applicable to them.
requirements.text: The AFS headlamp shall be fitted with a device enabling it to be so adjusted on the vehicle as to comply with the applicable rules.

requirements.quote: In all cases, only two different and clearly distinct settings, one for right hand and one for left-hand traffic, shall be possible
requirements.text: Where the AFS passing-beam is designed for both right-hand and left-hand traffic, only two different and clearly distinct settings shall be possible.

requirements.quote: the design shall preclude inadvertent shifting from one setting to the other or setting in an intermediate position.
requirements.text: Where the AFS passing-beam is designed for both traffic systems, the design shall preclude inadvertent shifting from one setting to the other or setting in an intermediate position.

requirements.quote: The device is robust enough to withstand 50,000 operations under normal conditions of use.
requirements.text: The AFS swivel and switching mechanism shall be robust enough to withstand 50,000 operations under normal conditions of use.

requirements.quote: Except in the case of adaptation of the driving-beam, either the passing-beam or the driving-beam shall always be obtained, without any possibility of remaining in an intermediate or undefined state
requirements.text: For the AFS, either the passing-beam or the driving-beam shall always be obtained without any possibility of remaining in an intermediate or undefined state.

requirements.quote: In the case of failure, it must be possible to obtain automatically a passing-beam or a state with respect to the photometric conditions which yields values not exceeding 1.30∙10³ cd in the zone III b
requirements.text: The AFS shall, in the case of failure, automatically obtain a passing-beam or a photometric state not exceeding 1.30∙10^3 cd in Zone III b and at least 3.40∙10^3 cd in a point of Zone Imax.

requirements.quote: The user cannot, with ordinary tools, change the shape or position of the moving parts, or influence the switching device.
requirements.text: The AFS shall be so made that the user cannot, with ordinary tools, change the shape or position of the moving parts or influence the switching device.

requirements.quote: The lamp shall only be equipped with: - replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128
requirements.text: The AFS headlamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light sources approved to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, light source modules and/or non-replaceable light sources.

requirements.quote: Road illumination devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.text: The AFS headlamp shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: it is tamperproof; and
requirements.text: Where replaceable light source modules are used, the module design shall be tamperproof.

requirements.quote: the total objective luminous flux of all light sources (UN approved light sources, light source modules and non-replaceable light sources) producing the principle passing-beam shall be equal or greater than the minimum values shown in Table 3a
requirements.text: The total objective luminous flux of all light sources producing the principal passing-beam shall be equal or greater than 1.00∙10^3 lm for an AFS-C basic passing-beam.

requirements.quote: If the outer lens of the lamp is made of plastic material tests shall be done according to the requirements in Annex 8.
requirements.text: Where the AFS outer lens is made of plastic material, the lens shall be tested according to the requirements of Annex 8.

requirements.quote: The sharpness and linearity of the cut-off, if applicable, shall be tested according to the requirements in Annex 6.
requirements.text: The sharpness and linearity of the AFS cut-off shall be tested according to the requirements of Annex 6.

requirements.quote: complementary tests shall be done according to the requirements in Annex 7 to ensure that in use there is no excessive change in photometric performance.
requirements.text: The AFS shall be subjected to the complementary tests of Annex 7 to ensure that in use there is no excessive change in photometric performance.

requirements.quote: a signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall be provided, according to the applicant’s selection of one or more of the following options
requirements.text: Where a specific function is realised with more than one element for visible radiation wired so that a failure of any one does not stop all of them, a signal indicating the failure shall be provided.

requirements.quote: The colour of the light emitted shall be white for all lamps.
requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the AFS shall be white.

requirements.quote: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.3 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.2 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28.0 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.text: For the 12 V system, the AFS shall be tested with a voltage supplied at the lamp of 13.2 V.

requirements.quote: Each system shall provide a Class C passing-beam according to paragraph 5.3.2.4. and one or more passing-beam(s) of additional class(es)
requirements.text: The AFS shall provide a Class C passing-beam and one or more passing-beams of additional classes.

requirements.quote: The system shall provide automatic modifications, such, that good road illumination is achieved and no discomfort is caused, neither to the driver nor to other road users.
requirements.text: The AFS shall provide automatic modifications such that good road illumination is achieved and no discomfort is caused to the driver or other road users.

requirements.quote: The system shall, prior to the subsequent test procedures, be set to the neutral state, emitting the Class C passing-beam.
requirements.text: The AFS shall emit the Class C passing-beam in the neutral state when set for the test procedures.

requirements.quote: When emitting a specified mode of the passing-beam, the system shall meet the requirements in the respective section (C, V, E, W) of part A of the Table 7
requirements.text: When emitting a specified mode of the passing-beam, the AFS shall meet the photometric requirements of the respective section (C, V, E, W) of Part A of Table 7 and of Table 8.

requirements.quote: the sum of the luminous intensity values provided by all contributors of the right or the left side of the system shall be at least 2.50∙10³ cd at one or more points
requirements.text: Where the T-signal corresponds to the smallest turn radius, the AFS bending mode shall provide at least 2.50∙10^3 cd at one or more points in the zone from H-H to 2° below H-H and from 10° to 45° to the turn side.

requirements.quote: Any specified passing-beam mode provides at least 2.50∙10³ cd at point 50V from each side of the system
requirements.text: Any specified AFS passing-beam mode shall provide at least 2.50∙10^3 cd at point 50V from each side of the system, except the Class V modes.

requirements.quote: The colour of the light emitted for Driver Assistance Projection shall be white.
requirements.text: Where the AFS produces a Driver Assistance Projection, the colour of the light emitted for the projection shall be white.

requirements.quote: The lighting unit(s) of the system shall be adjusted, according to the instructions of the manufacturer, such that the area of maximum illumination is centred on the point (HV)
requirements.text: The driving-beam lighting units of the AFS shall be adjusted so that the area of maximum illumination is centred on point HV.

requirements.quote: The system shall be so made that the lighting unit(s) of the right side and of the left side each provide at least 1.60∙10⁴ cd at the point HV.
requirements.text: The AFS shall be so made that the lighting units of the right side and of the left side each provide at least 1.60∙10^4 cd at point HV.

requirements.quote: The system shall be tested in the neutral state (central/straight), and, in addition in the state(s) corresponding to the smallest turn radius of the vehicle in both directions
requirements.text: The AFS bending mode shall be tested in the neutral state and in the states corresponding to the smallest turn radius of the vehicle in both directions.

requirements.quote: The system shall prior to the subsequent test procedures be set to the neutral state.
requirements.text: The AFS shall be set to the neutral state prior to the photometric measurement procedures.

requirements.quote: The lighting units of the system shall be measured individually; however, simultaneous measurements may be performed on two or more lighting units of an installation unit
requirements.text: The lighting units of the AFS shall be measured individually, except that simultaneous measurements may be made on units whose illuminating surfaces fit within 300 mm by 150 mm.

requirements.quote: In a dry and still atmosphere at an ambient temperature of 23 °C ± 5 °C, the test sample being mounted on a base representing the correct installation on the vehicle
requirements.text: The AFS stability test shall be carried out in a dry and still atmosphere at an ambient temperature of 23 °C ± 5 °C with the sample mounted on a base representing the correct installation.

requirements.quote: This test consists of verifying that the vertical drift of the cut-off line under the influence of heat does not exceed a specified value for an operating headlamp producing a passing-beam
requirements.text: The AFS shall be tested to verify that the vertical drift of the cut-off line under the influence of heat does not exceed the specified value.

requirements.quote: In case of headlamps or AFS, the absolute value Δ r1 = | r3 - r60 | recorded on the device is not more than 1.0 mrad (Δ r1 ≤ 1.0 mrad) upward and not more than 2.0 mrad
requirements.text: The AFS shall show a cut-off drift Δr1 of not more than 1.0 mrad upward and not more than 2.0 mrad downward.

requirements.quote: Three new samples (lenses) shall be subjected to five cycles of temperature and humidity (RH = relative humidity) change
requirements.text: Three new plastic lens samples of the AFS shall be subjected to five cycles of temperature and humidity change.

requirements.quote: The variation between the photometric values measured on each sample before and after the test shall not exceed 10 per cent including the tolerances of the photometric procedure.
requirements.text: After the temperature-change test, the variation between photometric values measured before and after shall not exceed 10 per cent.

requirements.quote: the outer face of the samples shall be free from cracks, scratches, chipping and deformation, and the mean variation in transmission
requirements.text: After the resistance-to-atmospheric-agents test, the outer face of the AFS lens samples shall be free from cracks, scratches, chipping and deformation.

requirements.quote: the mean value of the variation in transmission Δt = , measured on the three samples according to the procedure described in Appendix 2 shall not exceed 0.010 (Δtm < 0.010).
requirements.text: After the detergent and hydrocarbon tests, the mean variation in transmission of the AFS lens samples shall not exceed 0.010.

requirements.quote: no distortion, deformation, cracking or change in colour of either the headlamp lens or the external lens, if any, shall be noticeable.
requirements.text: After the 12-hour stability operation, no distortion, deformation, cracking or change in colour of the AFS lens shall be noticeable.

requirements.quote: Except for point B50L, a 10 per cent discrepancy between the photometric characteristics and the values measured prior to the test is permissible including the tolerances of the photometric procedure.
requirements.text: After the stability test, photometric values of the AFS passing-beam shall not differ by more than 10 per cent from the values measured before the test, except at point B50L.

requirements.quote: LED module(s) shall be so designed as to be and to remain in good working order when in normal use. They shall moreover exhibit no fault in design or manufacture.
requirements.text: The LED modules of the AFS shall be so designed as to remain in good working order in normal use and exhibit no fault in design or manufacture.

requirements.quote: Before the test each LED module shall be aged at least for seventy-two hours under the same conditions as in the corresponding headlamp application.
requirements.text: Each LED module shall be aged at least 72 hours under headlamp application conditions before the flux measurement.

requirements.quote: In the case of road illumination devices incorporating an outer lens of plastic material, the group of letters "PL" to be affixed near the symbols identifying the function(s);
requirements.text: The AFS headlamp with a plastic outer lens shall bear the group of letters "PL" near the symbols identifying the functions.

requirements.quote: In the case of AFS, in addition the symbol “T”, after the symbol(s) of all lighting function(s) and/or class(es) designed to comply with the respective bend lighting provisions
requirements.text: The AFS shall bear the symbol "T" after the symbols of all lighting functions and/or classes designed to comply with the bend lighting provisions.

requirements.quote: In the case of AFS, a score above the letter(s) indicates that the AFS function(s) is(are) provided by more than one installation unit on that side of the system.
requirements.text: Where an AFS function is provided by more than one installation unit on one side, the AFS shall bear a score above the corresponding letter(s).

requirements.quote: In the case of AFS, front fog lamps and headlamps except Class AS, BS, CS, and DS meeting the requirements of Annex 7 only when supplied with a voltage of 12V, a marking consisting of the Number 24 crossed out by an oblique cross (X)
requirements.text: The AFS shall bear, near the light source holders, a marking consisting of the number 24 crossed out by an oblique cross.

requirements.quote: the Unique Identifier or the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle
requirements.text: The AFS approval marking shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or a door is opened.

requirements.quote: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.text: Where the AFS outer lens is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable lens and the main body.

requirements.quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.text: All markings on the AFS shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.quote: The value for “a” in part 1 of Annex 13 shall be at least 5 mm on plastic material and at least 8 mm on glass.
requirements.text: The dimension "a" of the AFS approval marking shall be at least 5 mm on the plastic lens material.

requirements.quote: In the case of lamps with light source module(s), a marking on the light source module(s) indicating: (a) The trade name or mark of the applicant;
requirements.text: Each light source module of the AFS shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.

requirements.quote: This specific identification code shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE” followed by the markings as described in paragraphs 3.3.2.1.
requirements.text: Each light source module of the AFS shall bear a specific identification code starting with the letters "MD".

requirements.quote: Adaptive Front lighting System (Class AFS-C): basic passing-beam XC³
requirements.text: The AFS basic passing-beam shall be identified by the symbol "XC".

requirements.quote: Adaptive Front lighting System (Class AFS-E): motorway passing-beam XCE1, 2
requirements.text: The AFS motorway passing-beam shall be identified by the symbol "XCE".

requirements.quote: Adaptive Front lighting System (Class AFS-V): town passing-beam XCV3, 4
requirements.text: The AFS town passing-beam shall be identified by the symbol "XCV".

requirements.quote: Adaptive Front lighting System (Class AFS-W): adverse weather passing-beam XCW3, 4
requirements.text: The AFS adverse weather passing-beam shall be identified by the symbol "XCW".

requirements.quote: Cornering lamp of Class K K
requirements.text: The cornering lamp of the AFS shall be identified by the symbol "K".

requirements.quote: Adaptive Front lighting System (Class AFS-C): basic passing-beam 0 1
requirements.text: The AFS-C basic passing-beam shall carry change index 1 for the 01 series of amendments.

requirements.quote: The cornering lamp shall be installed on the goniometer according to Annex 5, paragraph 3.5. including the allowed specific tolerances of paragraph 4.
requirements.text: The cornering lamp shall be installed on the goniometer according to Annex 5, paragraph 3.5, including the allowed tolerances of paragraph 4.

requirements.quote: For a left side lamp, the intensity of the light at the specified measuring points and zones shall be as indicated in Table 18.
requirements.text: The left-side cornering lamp shall provide at least 3.75∙10^2 cd at point P1 (2.5°D, 30°L).
The left-side cornering lamp shall provide at least 6.25∙10^2 cd at point P2 (2.5°D, 45°L).

requirements.quote: Zone 1 Above 1°U 90°L to 90°R - 3.00∙10²
requirements.text: The cornering lamp shall not exceed 3.00∙10^2 cd in Zone 1 above 1°U.

requirements.quote: Zone 3 Below 0° 90°L to 90°R - 1.40∙10⁴
requirements.text: The cornering lamp shall not exceed 1.40∙10^4 cd in Zone 3 below 0°.

requirements.quote: For cornering lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.text: The cornering lamp luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

requirements.quote: Cornering lamp 1 45°L 2.5°D resp. 45°R 2.5°D
requirements.text: The cornering lamp shall be checked for compliance at the point 45°L 2.5°D (or 45°R 2.5°D) 1 second after activation.

requirements.quote: The luminous intensity distribution and the colour of the light emitted are measured and checked for compliance after photometric stability (as defined in UN Regulation No. 48).
requirements.text: The AFS luminous intensity distribution and colour shall be measured after photometric stability has occurred.

requirements.quote: The aiming shall be carried out using a flat vertical screen set up at a distance of 10 m or 25 m
requirements.text: The AFS shall be aimed using a flat vertical screen set up at a distance of 10 m or 25 m forward of the device.

requirements.quote: For vertical adjustment: the horizontal part of the "cut-off" is moved upward from below line B and adjusted to its nominal position one per cent (0.57°) below the H-H line;
requirements.text: For vertical adjustment of the AFS basic passing-beam, the horizontal part of the cut-off shall be adjusted to its nominal position 0.57° below the H-H line.

requirements.quote: The value of G shall not be less than: (a) 0.13 (minimum sharpness) for passing-beam designed to provide asymmetric “cut-off” line
requirements.text: The sharpness factor G of the AFS asymmetric cut-off shall not be less than 0.13.

requirements.quote: The maximum vertical distance between the inflection points determined shall not exceed: (a) 0.2° for passing-beam designed to provide asymmetric “cut-off” line;
requirements.text: The maximum vertical distance between the inflection points of the AFS asymmetric cut-off shall not exceed 0.2°.

requirements.quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible,
requirements.text: All markings on the front position lamp grouped with the AFS shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.text: The value "a" of the approval marking of the grouped light-signalling lamp shall be at least 5 mm.

requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage
requirements.text: The grouped light-signalling lamp with electronic control gear or non-replaceable light sources shall bear the marking of the rated voltage or range of voltage.

requirements.quote: The specific identification code of the module; This specific identification code shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE”
requirements.text: Each replaceable light source module of the grouped lamp shall bear a specific identification code starting with "MD".

requirements.quote: the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle
requirements.text: The approval marking of the grouped light-signalling lamp shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle.

requirements.quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured
requirements.text: The grouped light-signalling lamp shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use and notwithstanding vibrations, its satisfactory operation remains assured.

requirements.quote: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.text: The grouped light-signalling lamp shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the grouped light-signalling lamp shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function.

requirements.quote: The colour of the light emitted shall be white, however the lamp identified by symbol MA may be amber.
requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the front position lamp shall be white.
The front position lamp shall provide a minimum luminous intensity of 4.0 cd on the reference axis and a maximum of 1.40∙10^2 cd.

requirements.quote: The colour of the light emitted shall be white.
requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the daytime running lamp shall be white.

requirements.quote: The area of the apparent surface in the direction of the axis of reference of the daytime running lamp shall be not less than 25 cm² and not more than 200 cm².
requirements.text: The apparent surface of the daytime running lamp shall be not less than 25 cm2 and not more than 200 cm2.

requirements.quote: The colour of light emitted shall be amber.
requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the direction indicator lamp shall be amber.

requirements.quote: Each light source, after its activation, shall remain lit until the end of the ON cycle;
requirements.text: Where the direction indicator lamp uses sequential activation, each light source shall remain lit until the end of the ON cycle.

requirements.quote: The colour of light emitted shall be red.
requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.

requirements.quote: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply
requirements.text: Where a single lamp contains more than one light source, at least one failure provision (minimum intensity maintained or a tell-tale activation signal) shall apply.

requirements.quote: The design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one
requirements.text: Where replaceable light sources are used, the lamp design shall ensure they can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.

requirements.quote: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
requirements.text: During the photometric measurements of the light-signalling lamp, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.

requirements.quote: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.text: For the 12 V system, the light-signalling lamp shall be tested with a voltage supplied at the lamp of 13.5 V.

requirements.quote: when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.
requirements.text: When a replaceable light source module is removed and replaced by another module bearing the same identification code, the photometric requirements of the device shall still be met.

requirements.quote: The daytime running lamp shall be subjected to the heat resistance test specified in Annex 6.
requirements.text: The daytime running lamp shall be subjected to the heat resistance test specified in Annex 6.

requirements.quote: After the lamp has been stabilized at the ambient temperature, no distortion, deformation, cracking or colour modification shall be perceptible.
requirements.text: After the heat resistance test, no distortion, deformation, cracking or colour modification of the lamp shall be perceptible.

requirements.quote: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light pattern should be substantially uniform
requirements.text: Within the light distribution field of the light-signalling lamp, the light pattern shall be substantially uniform.

requirements.quote: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of: (a) Direction indicators categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12;
requirements.text: A direction indicator lamp that cannot be mounted on either side indiscriminately shall bear a horizontal arrow directed outwards from the vehicle.
The S1 stop lamp shall provide a minimum luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd and a maximum of 2.60∙10^2 cd.
The category 1 front direction indicator lamp shall provide a minimum luminous intensity of 1.75∙10^2 cd and a maximum of 1.20∙10^3 cd.

requirements.quote: One, type-approved according to the 01 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be fitted with one adaptive front lighting system type-approved according to UN Regulation No. 149.

requirements.quote: The AFS shall, prior to the subsequent test procedures, be set to the neutral state;
requirements.text: The installed AFS shall be set to the neutral state prior to the installation test procedures.

requirements.quote: Two symmetrically placed lighting units shall be positioned at a height in compliance with the requirements of the relevant paragraphs 6.1.4. and 6.2.4.
requirements.text: Two symmetrically placed AFS lighting units shall be positioned at a height complying with the main-beam and dipped-beam mounting requirements.

requirements.quote: Additional lighting units, if any, on either side of the vehicle shall be positioned at a distance not exceeding 140 mm¹³ in horizontal direction (E in the figure) and 400 mm in vertical direction
requirements.text: Additional AFS lighting units on either side shall be positioned not more than 140 mm horizontally and 400 mm vertically from the nearest lighting unit.

requirements.quote: None of the additional lighting units described in paragraph 6.22.4.1.2. above shall be positioned lower than 250 mm (F in the figure) nor higher than indicated in paragraph 6.2.4.2.
requirements.text: Additional AFS lighting units shall not be positioned lower than 250 mm above the ground nor higher than the dipped-beam maximum height.

requirements.quote: The outer edge of the apparent surface of at least one lighting unit on each side of the vehicle shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle
requirements.text: For each passing-beam mode, the outer edge of at least one AFS lighting unit on each side shall be not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: All lighting units of an AFS shall be mounted at the front.
requirements.text: All lighting units of the AFS shall be mounted at the front of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: The angles of geometric visibility prescribed for the respective lighting functions according to paragraphs 6.1.5. and 6.2.5. of this Regulation, shall be met by at least one of the lighting units
requirements.text: On each side of the vehicle, the geometric visibility angles shall be met by at least one of the simultaneously energized AFS lighting units for each function and mode.

requirements.quote: The downward inclination of the horizontal part of the "cut-off" of the basic passing-beam shall remain between the limits indicated in paragraph 6.2.6.1.2. under all the static loading conditions
requirements.text: The downward inclination of the AFS basic passing-beam cut-off shall remain within the limits of paragraph 6.2.6.1.2 under all static loading conditions.

requirements.quote: In the case where a headlamp levelling device is necessary to satisfy the requirements of paragraph 6.22.6.1.2., the device shall be automatic.
requirements.text: Where a levelling device is necessary to satisfy the AFS cut-off inclination limits, the levelling device shall be automatic.

requirements.quote: In the event of a failure of this device, the basic passing beam shall not assume a position in which the vertical inclination is less downward than it was at the time when the failure of the device occurred.
requirements.text: In the event of a failure of the levelling device, the AFS basic passing-beam shall not assume a position with less downward vertical inclination than at the moment of failure.

requirements.quote: For each lighting unit the kink of the elbow of the cut-off line, if any, when projected on the screen, shall coincide with the vertical line through the reference axis of said lighting unit.
requirements.text: For each AFS lighting unit, the kink of the elbow of the cut-off line shall coincide with the vertical line through the reference axis of that lighting unit.

requirements.quote: The changes within and between the provided classes and their modes of the AFS lighting functions as specified below, shall be performed automatically without causing discomfort, distraction or glare
requirements.text: The changes between classes and modes of the AFS passing-beam shall be performed automatically without causing discomfort, distraction or glare to the driver or other road users.

requirements.quote: The class C mode(s) of the passing-beam shall be activated if no mode of another passing-beam class is activated.
requirements.text: The AFS shall activate the Class C passing-beam mode when no mode of another passing-beam class is activated.

requirements.quote: The class V mode(s) of the passing-beam shall not operate unless one or more of the following conditions is/are automatically detected (V-signal applies)
requirements.text: The AFS Class V town passing-beam mode shall not operate unless the V-signal conditions, such as a vehicle speed not exceeding 60 km/h on built-up roads, are automatically detected.

requirements.quote: The class E mode(s) of the passing-beam shall not operate unless the vehicle's speed exceeds 60 km/h
requirements.text: The AFS Class E motorway passing-beam mode shall not operate unless the vehicle speed exceeds 60 km/h and the E-signal conditions are detected.

requirements.quote: The class W-mode(s) of the passing-beam shall not operate unless the front fog lamps, if any, are switched OFF and one or more of the following conditions is/are automatically detected
requirements.text: The AFS Class W adverse-weather passing-beam mode shall not operate unless the front fog lamps are switched OFF and the W-signal conditions, such as a detected wet road, are met.

requirements.quote: One or more lighting units may be additionally energized only when the horizontal radius of curvature of the trajectory of the centre of gravity of the vehicle is 500 m or less.
requirements.text: Additional AFS lighting units shall be energized for bend lighting only when the horizontal radius of curvature of the vehicle's centre of gravity trajectory is 500 m or less.

requirements.quote: It shall always be possible for the driver to set the AFS to the neutral state and to return it to its automatic operation.
requirements.text: The AFS shall always allow the driver to set the system to the neutral state and to return it to automatic operation.

requirements.quote: A visual failure tell-tale for AFS is mandatory. It shall be non-flashing.
requirements.text: The AFS shall provide a non-flashing visual failure tell-tale that is activated whenever a failure of the AFS control signals is detected.

requirements.quote: An AFS shall be permitted only in conjunction with the installation of headlamp cleaning device(s) according to UN Regulation No. 45¹⁶
requirements.text: The AFS shall be installed only in conjunction with headlamp cleaning devices where the luminous flux of the Class C passing-beam units exceeds 2,000 lm on at least one side.

requirements.quote: Cornering lamp: White
requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the cornering lamp shall be white.

requirements.quote: Adaptive front-lighting systems (AFS): White
requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the AFS shall be white.

requirements.quote: Where an AFS is fitted, it shall be considered equivalent to a pair of dipped-beam headlamps and, if it provides main-beam function(s), it shall be considered equivalent to a pair of main-beam headlamps.
requirements.text: The installed AFS shall be considered equivalent to a pair of dipped-beam headlamps and, if it provides main-beam functions, equivalent to a pair of main-beam headlamps.

requirements.quote: In height: minimum: Not less than 250 mm above the ground; maximum: Not more than 900 mm above the ground.
requirements.text: The cornering lamp shall be mounted not less than 250 mm and not more than 900 mm above the ground.

requirements.quote: In length: not further than 1,000 mm from the front.
requirements.text: The cornering lamp shall be mounted not further than 1,000 mm from the front of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: α = 10° upwards and downwards, β = 30° to 60° outwards.
requirements.text: The cornering lamp shall meet geometric visibility angles of 10° upwards and downwards and 30° to 60° outwards.

requirements.quote: The cornering lamps shall be so connected that they cannot be switched ON unless the main-beam headlamps or the dipped-beam headlamps are switched ON at the same time.
requirements.text: The cornering lamp shall be connected so that it cannot be switched ON unless the main-beam or dipped-beam headlamps are switched ON at the same time.

requirements.quote: The cornering lamp on one side of the vehicle may only be switched ON automatically when the direction-indicators on the same side of the vehicle are switched ON and/or when the steering angle is changed from the straight-ahead position
requirements.text: The cornering lamp on one side may be switched ON automatically only when the direction indicators on that side are switched ON and/or the steering angle is turned towards that side.

requirements.quote: The cornering lamps shall not be switched ON at vehicle speeds above 40 km/h.
requirements.text: The cornering lamp shall not be switched ON at vehicle speeds above 40 km/h.

requirements.quote: In case an AFS providing a bending mode is installed, the front position lamp may be swivelled together with a lighting unit to which it is reciprocally incorporated.
requirements.text: Where the front position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with an AFS bending lighting unit, it may be swivelled together with that lighting unit.

requirements.quote: A tell-tale indicating failure, whether flashing or not, is mandatory: (a) In the case where the whole beam or the kink of the elbow of the cut-off is moved to produce bend lighting;
requirements.text: Where the whole beam or the kink of the cut-off is moved to produce bend lighting, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory.

requirements.quote: In any case, once activated, it shall remain activated while the failure is present.
requirements.text: The bend-lighting failure tell-tale shall remain activated while the failure is present.

requirements.quote: Dipped-beam headlamps with light source(s) and/or light source module(s) producing the principal dipped beam having a total objective luminous flux for at least one headlamp which exceeds 2,000 lumens shall only be installed in conjunction with the installation of headlamp cleaning device(s)
requirements.text: Where the dipped-beam light sources produce a total objective luminous flux exceeding 2,000 lm for at least one headlamp, headlamp cleaning devices shall be installed.

requirements.quote: One additional light source or one or more LED module(s), located inside the dipped-beam headlamps or in a lamp (except the main-beam headlamp) grouped or reciprocally incorporated with the respective dipped-beam headlamps, may be activated to produce bend lighting
requirements.text: Additional light sources for bend lighting may be activated only when the horizontal radius of curvature of the vehicle trajectory is 500 m or less.

requirements.quote: If bend lighting is produced by a horizontal movement of the whole beam or the kink of the elbow of the cut-off, it shall be switched ON only if the vehicle is in forward motion
requirements.text: Where bend lighting is produced by horizontal movement of the whole beam or the cut-off kink, it shall be switched ON only if the vehicle is in forward motion.

requirements.quote: The horizontal orientation of one or both dipped-beam headlamps may be varied to produce bend lighting, provided that if the whole beam or the kink of the elbow of the cut-off is moved, the kink of the elbow of the cut-off shall not intersect the line of the trajectory of the centre of gravity
requirements.text: Where the kink of the elbow of the cut-off is moved to produce bend lighting, it shall not intersect the vehicle's centre-of-gravity trajectory at a distance from the front larger than 100 times the mounting height.

requirements.quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed
requirements.text: The AFS shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding vibrations it retains the prescribed characteristics.

requirements.quote: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.text: The installed AFS lamps shall not be capable of being inadvertently maladjusted.

requirements.quote: The illuminating lamps described in paragraphs 2.5.1., 2.5.2. and 2.5.10. shall be so installed that correct adjustment of their orientation can easily be carried out.
requirements.text: The AFS shall be so installed that correct adjustment of the orientation of its lighting units can easily be carried out.

requirements.quote: Satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.text: The two AFS lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.

requirements.quote: Be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp;
requirements.text: The two lamps of the AFS pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, except as regards the interior structure of the lamp.

requirements.quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.text: The AFS installed on the vehicle shall be type-approved according to UN Regulation No. 149.

requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.
requirements.text: The AFS height and orientation shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and on a flat horizontal surface, with the system in its neutral state.

requirements.quote: the technical service shall perform a test drive which comprises any situation relevant to the system control on the basis of the applicants description; it shall be notified whether all modes are activated, performing and de-activated
requirements.text: The AFS automatic operation shall be verified in a test drive covering all situations relevant to the system control, confirming that all modes are activated, perform and de-activate as described.

requirements.quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.text: The AFS and its electronic control unit shall be designed, constructed and fitted so as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the electromagnetic compatibility requirements.

requirements.quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.text: The AFS control unit, as an ESA, shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions and for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.

requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz
requirements.text: The AFS control unit shall have broadband radiated emissions not exceeding 62 to 52 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz band and 52 to 63 dBµV/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band
requirements.text: The AFS control unit shall have narrowband radiated emissions not exceeding 52 to 42 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz band and 42 to 53 dBµV/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band.

requirements.quote: Positive +75 V +150 V Negative -100 V -450 V
requirements.text: The AFS control unit on the 12 V system shall not emit transient conducted disturbances on supply lines exceeding +75 V positive and -100 V negative pulse amplitude.

requirements.quote: Test level below 2 GHz 60 V/m 75 V/m 60 mA 30 V/m 21 V/m
requirements.text: The AFS control unit shall withstand an immunity test level of 30 V/m in the ALSE method over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.quote: 1 -75 V -450 V 500 pulses III III
requirements.text: The AFS control unit shall withstand test pulse 1 of -75 V for 500 pulses with functional performance status class III for immunity-related functions.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 28 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 35 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.text: The vehicle's narrowband radiated emissions measured with a 10 m antenna distance shall not exceed 28 dBµV/m in the 30 to 230 MHz band and 35 dBµV/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz band.

requirements.quote: the field strength shall be 30 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 25 volts/m over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.text: The vehicle immunity to radiated disturbances shall be tested at 30 V/m over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz band and a minimum of 25 V/m over the whole band.

requirements.quote: during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 6, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions"
requirements.text: During the immunity tests, there shall be no degradation of performance of the immunity-related functions, including the dipped beam.

requirements.quote: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.text: The AFS control unit, as an ESA, shall bear the UN R10 approval mark when conforming to an approved type.

requirements.quote: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.text: The UN R10 approval mark of the AFS control unit shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the approving country.

requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1. above.
requirements.text: The UN R10 approval mark of the AFS control unit shall comprise the number of the regulation, the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle.

requirements.quote: Markings on ESAs in conformity with paragraph 5.3. above need not be visible when the ESA is installed in the vehicle.
requirements.text: The UN R10 approval mark on the AFS control unit need not be visible when the ESA is installed in the vehicle.

requirements.quote: The sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.text: The AFS control unit samples shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.

requirements.quote: production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits
requirements.text: The AFS control unit shall be so manufactured that in production its emitted disturbance levels do not exceed the reference limits by more than 4 dB.
